note: PRE reproduced and frozen BEFORE any edit. All three findings are mine.

E6_lock_not_directory_durable.verdict: the lock file was fsynced but its DIRECTORY ENTRY was not, on acquire or on release; after a crash/reboot the entry could be absent though the effect transaction had begun, letting another process enter.

E7_asset_id_not_an_instance_identity.reproducer: the position was closed elsewhere and REOPENED at entry 480 (was 500), same asset_id, same side, same quantity
E7_asset_id_not_an_instance_identity.verdict: coincidentally identical reopened exposure inherited an old close request and the plan COMPLETED — the equality check compared only asset/side/units, and the contract omitted the entry price.

E8_local_wrapper_freshness.wrapper_observed_at: inserted by the caller before parsing
E8_local_wrapper_freshness.verdict: the terminal body had NO venue timestamp; a year-old replayed body inside a freshly stamped local wrapper verified as fresh. Authority and freshness did not come from original venue bytes — the same distinction the owner-authorized C7 capture demonstrated for open orders.

E6.uncertain_acquire: a failing file fsync or parent fsync raises typed PlanLockHeld, execution is blocked, and the lock STAYS — a future claimant refuses and an operator disposes
E6.uncertain_release: raises a typed ExecutorError and leaves the lock standing; the surviving lock refuses the next claimant — fail-closed, never a silent second entrant. The effects that already ran are not retracted and not repeated.
injected_failures: the surviving lock refusing a fresh claimant
E6.fresh_process_recovery: after a clean release a new executor resumes the completed plan idempotently

identity_kind_stated_by_the_parsers.mt5: venue_position_instance (a reopened position receives a new ticket)
identity_kind_stated_by_the_parsers.alpaca: asset_identity_only (a reopened position carries the SAME asset_id)

E7.reissue_rule: without a venue position-instance identity an unacknowledged close is CATEGORICALLY unresolved for operator disposition, even for a position identical in side, quantity and price. With the MT5 ticket, only the same ticket + side + units + entry price through a port declaring same_key_idempotent_reduce_only retries, with the SAME key.

alpaca_reopened_entry_480.incident: the venue supplies no position-instance identity …

two_process_close_boundary_split.close_alpaca: zero — nobody may reissue without an instance identity

E8.payload_shape: the venue's ARRAY of order objects; the old local wrapper is refused outright as 'a local construction, not venue bytes'
E8.freshness_source: the venue's own event timestamps — Alpaca updated_at, MT5 done_time — with the evidence stamped at the LATEST event; an empty body refuses because absence is never a verdict
E8.acquisition_receipt: typed AcquisitionReceipt OUTSIDE the payload: collector_source, collector_code_identity, received_at, monotonic_seq, and body_sha256 binding the exact venue bytes

refusals_observed.missing_receipt: terminal evidence without a receipt refuses at parse
refusals_observed.body_envelope_substitution: the acquisition receipt does not bind these bytes — refused
refusals_observed.receipt_predating_the_event: an event cannot be received before it happened — refused
refusals_observed.replayed_body_fresh_receipt: evidence is 31536000.000s old and the policy allows 120.000s — stale evidence is refused

E8.provenance: the receipt travels in the gate's journaled provenance

mutation_check: dropping both lock parent fsyncs, the instance-identity gate and the receipt byte-binding broke exactly the tests claiming those properties (3 failures); green on revert.
boundaries: E1-E5 and C7-C10 preserved. Implementation and effect-free tests only: no service change, no venue connection, no order command, no position change. WP4 and live activation remain blocked pending independent reproduction.
